steps.thought: List all available station tests to check available diagnostics and their costs.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run the power_on_selftest to quickly check all major buses and devices for initial faults.
steps.observation: The power on selftest passed successfully, enumerating all expected I2C, UART, and CAN devices with a normal boot time and no reported failures.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial power on selftest passed, but all other subsystems still need to be checked before confirming unit is healthy.
ESC functionality not yet tested under load.
Motors not yet spun up to test for mechanical issues.
Battery under-load and rest checks not yet run.
IMU static noise and bias tests not yet performed.

steps.thought: Run battery_rest_check to verify cell balance and rest voltage before proceeding to more expensive subsystem tests.
steps.observation: The battery rest check passed successfully, showing normal pack voltage (16.60 V) and very low cell imbalance (7 mV) with no failures.

hypotheses.rationale: Power on and battery rest checks have both passed cleanly, though other subsystems remain to be tested.
ESC telemetry and motor tests have not yet been performed.
Motor spin test is required to check for mechanical noise or bearing wear.
IMU static test has not yet been executed.
Compass static and motor interference tests are pending.

steps.thought: I will run the esc_telemetry test to check for any commutation issues, packet loss, or sync errors across all ESCs.
steps.observation: ESC telemetry test passed with minimal packet loss and zero/low sync errors across all ESCs, ruling out major ESC faults.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial system, battery, and ESC checks have all passed successfully.
Motor spin test is still needed to check for mechanical wear or bearing noise.
IMU static test has not yet been executed.
Compass static and motor interference tests are pending.
Other subsystems such as camera, compass, and IMU still need to be tested.

steps.thought: I will run the compass_static test to check for static heading deviations and continue covering all remaining subsystems.
steps.observation: The compass_static test passed successfully with a tiny heading error (-0.14 deg) and normal field magnitude, ruling out severe compass calibration or hard-iron issues.

hypotheses.rationale: System, battery, ESC, and compass static tests have all passed without any failures.
IMU static test is pending to fully evaluate gyro bias and sensor health.
Motor spin test has not yet been performed to check mechanical performance.
Camera self-test is still required to verify imaging sensor integrity.
Remaining subsystems (camera, IMU, motors) are yet to be fully tested.

steps.thought: I will run the imu_static test to check for gyro bias, sensor noise, and dropouts, ensuring the IMU subsystem is healthy.
steps.observation: The imu_static test passed with low gyro bias, normal accel noise, and zero dropped samples. This rules out major IMU sensor faults and miscalibration.

hypotheses.rationale: System, battery, ESC, compass, and IMU static tests have all passed successfully without any failures.
Motor spin test has not yet been performed to check mechanical performance under load.
Camera self-test is still required to verify imaging sensor integrity.
Remaining subsystems (camera, motors) are yet to be fully tested.

steps.thought: Run camera_selftest to check camera module and CSI ribbon integrity, ensuring all subsystems are covered as required for healthy units.
steps.observation: The camera_selftest failed due to a low frame rate (24 fps) and 98 CSI CRC errors, indicating a fault associated with the camera subsystem.

hypotheses.rationale: High CSI CRC errors and low frame rate during camera self-test point strongly to a faulty or poorly seated camera ribbon cable.
Sensor ID is OK, but the selftest failed, making a complete sensor failure a less likely alternative to a ribbon fault.
Could contribute to frame rate issues, though CRC errors usually suggest signal integrity issues on the CSI bus.

steps.thought: The camera_selftest failed due to high CSI CRC errors and low frame rate. Since the sensor ID was ok, reseating or checking the ribbon cable is the most likely fix, but we can confirm the camera subsystem is otherwise healthy. Proposing rework now.
